info.title: Scouting Platform API (Super Admin & Multi-Tenant Clubs)
info.description:
Complete API specification for the Scouting multi-tenant platform.

## Hosts

| Host | Serves |
|---|---|
| `sportego.org` | Super Admin API |
| `admin.sportego.org`, `api.sportego.org`, `www.sportego.org` | Super Admin API (reserved labels) |
| `<club>.sportego.org` | Tenant API of that club (e.g. `ahly.sportego.org`) |

The tenant is the **first label before the dot**: `ahly.sportego.org` -> club `ahly` -> MongoDB database `ahly`.
Every club owns a separate database, and a token issued for one club is rejected by another.

Super Admin routes (`/api/auth`, `/api/clubs`, ...) are reachable from the apex and from the reserved hosts only;
a request from a tenant host such as `ahly.sportego.org/api/clubs` returns **403**.

`/api/tenant/*` also accepts the `x-subdomain` header or the `?subdomain=` query parameter,
which is what the local development server and mobile clients use.

subdomain.description: Club subdomain identifier (also the database name)

SuperAdminAuth.description: Super Admin JWT token returned from POST /api/auth/login

TenantAuth.description: Tenant JWT token returned from POST /api/tenant/auth/login

TenantSubdomain.name: x-subdomain
TenantSubdomain.description: Club subdomain (e.g. 'ahly'). Optional in production: the tenant is taken from the host (`ahly.sportego.org`). Required on localhost or when calling the API from the apex domain.

post.description: Creates a pending order on behalf of a club. `payment_proof` can be sent as a URL or as an uploaded file (`multipart/form-data`). New orders stay `pending` until a super admin approves them.

patch.description: Same handler as `PUT /api/tenant/auth/change-password`. Changing the password revokes every previously issued tenant token (`password_version`).

get.description: Returns everything the tenant dashboard needs on initial load: club profile, days left in subscription, database name, settings, and entity counts.

get.summary: Browse Available Packages to Buy / Renew
get.description: Returns all active subscription packages with calculated savings, durations, and whether the package is the club's current active plan.
Returns active payment methods where clubs can transfer subscription fees (e.g. InstaPay address, Vodafone Cash, Bank Account).
Returns all past and current package orders made by this club, with approval status and pricing snapshots.

post.description: Instantly creates a pending order for this club (without needing separate cart steps). Also logs the purchase in the club's cart collection for synchronization.

example.message: Package purchased successfully. Your order is pending super admin approval.
